scope: test_frozen_copy_ambiguous.py: test_a_call_reissued_under_a_max_age_bound_is_ambiguous is renamed to ..._takes_the_reissue_status and expects `stored` with no `capture.partial.ambiguous` (R2); in three tests the first transport step changes from httpx.ConnectError to httpx.ReadError with their assertions unchanged (R3). test_frozen_copy_calls.py: the ConnectError row of the transport table expects `error` instead of `ambiguous` (R3), and a ReadError row expecting `ambiguous` is added. Each changed line carries an `OME-1775 (owner-approved, D5)` note. All other edits to these files only add tests.
reason: OME-1775 (spec docs/spec/2026-10-29-OME-1775-cancelled-call-not-partial.md §4): a max-age re-issue whose last response is 2xx takes that response's capture status (R2), and a connect-phase transport failure (ConnectError, ConnectTimeout, PoolTimeout) sent no byte, so it no longer makes a call ambiguous (R3). Owner decision D5 (2026-10-29) approved every prior test that asserts `ambiguous` after a connect-phase failure or after a max-age re-issue with a 2xx stored last response; plan P2 approved these five.
